nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Cream

segments.oily: Multiple oily-skin reviewers say the cream hydrates without adding grease or shine, does not clog pores, and layers well under makeup, though one still calls it a bit heavy for acne-prone oily skin depending on cleansing.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including one post-chemical-peel and one using tretinoin, report the cream feels rich and quenching despite its light texture, though one with normal-to-dry skin says it under-hydrates the driest patches and needs layering with a heavier cream.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as lightweight, balancing oily T-zone and dry areas, and suitable for daytime wear under makeup.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and hypersensitive reviewers, including some with eczema, rosacea, or reactive/allergy-prone skin, report no irritation, redness, or burning and describe it as calming and fragrance-free; one reviewer, however, developed severe painful acne and suspects a birch/tree allergy.
segments.mature: One 56-year-old combination-skin reviewer in a dry desert climate calls it essential to her routine, and a 36-year-old in a dry climate says it keeps her skin quenched and dewy.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers past their mid-30s describe the cream as keeping skin looking dewy, plump, and glowing in dry climates; no anti-aging claims beyond hydration and radiance are made.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those in dry, cold, or desert climates, and post-peel or tretinoin users, report strong, lasting hydration without stickiness; a couple with drier or normal-to-dry skin still needed to layer a heavier moisturizer for full effect.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea and generally reactive skin report the cream calms and cools without triggering redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema and compromised or post-procedure skin describe the cream as soothing and repairing, with no reports of irritation from this group.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using benzoyl peroxide or adapalene report the cream layers well and does not irritate, though one needed an extra night cream since it did not hydrate enough on top of drying acne medication.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers, including those with cystic or clog-prone skin, report no new breakouts and some clearing of whiteheads; one reviewer reports the worst, most painful acne of her life after two months, suspecting a birch allergy, and one notes it may feel heavy for acne-prone skin if cleansing/toning is inadequate.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently say it hydrates without adding shine or grease and helps skin look balanced rather than oily under makeup.

extraits.texte: I bought this after many days of checking reviews for negative feedback. It's been 2 months and I have the worst, most painful acne I've ever had in my entire life. It get worse every week. My cheeks and jaw bone are covered in large, red, iritated pimples (some in clusters), and scars from the previous weeks. I stopped every other product in my skincare routine to try to narrow down what was causing this reaction. I'n now only using this and a sensitive bar soap to cleanse, so it has to be this product. I found other people on reddit who have had similar reactions to this brand's birch juice line. So if you have seasonal allergies or are allergic to any tree species, do not buy any of the birch products!

Overall this was one of the nicest creams I've ever tried, and I love how it sits on my skin and under my makeup but ... I really wish it didn't have those little beads in it because they're pretty tough to blend into the skin. Even if I rub the product between my hands before applying it, I still can't manage to pop them all, which leads to them ... sitting on my face, and me having to brush them off. If this cream didn't have those little beads it'd absolutely be my holy grail daytime moisturizer -- I'll finish the tub I have, but I don't know if I'll repurchase. I'd recommend it if you don't mind those un-popable beads!

I love the moisturizer, i have dry acne prone skin. I use this a base/ barrier moisturizer then will layer a heavy moisturizer or spf on top. Zero burring or irritation or acne. On my third jar, i use it morning and nignt

I tried this moisturizer (i use the sunblock and love that too) to see if my skin will tolerate it and it did! I am a convert. I used to use the Obagi moisturizer but this is my moisturizer now. My skin loves and it does not irritate nor react to it. Just gives me a healthy, dewy skin. LOVE LOVE LOVE this!

This is hands down the most luxurious feeling moisturizer I've ever used. It's pretty lightweight but somehow rich enough to hydrate my VERY dry skin. It's also helped me keep the crusty skin I get between my eyebrows in check!
